notes.title: ⚔️ Patch V1.3.5 – Dungeon Expansion, Elite Monsters & More!
notes.content:
Dungeon Expansion, Elite Monsters & More!
Hi Hunters!

I'm back with some exciting news! After yesterday’s release of the new event mini-dungeon, I went straight back to work fixing a few bugs. But while doing that, I figured... why stop there? So, I’ve added even more content for you to enjoy right now. Let’s dive into the details:
[hr][/hr]🕳️ Event Mini-Dungeon Expansion
The event dungeon just got a makeover! It’s now bigger, with more resource nodes to farm. This improvement should make your gathering and crafting journey a lot more rewarding!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/4f0840f3f30905803e7578c3616937d7c0f209a5.png"]
[hr][/hr]👑 New Elite Monster: Goblin King - Elite Variant
Introducing a more dangerous version of the Goblin King!
This elite foe is stronger and comes with enhanced loot drops. If you think you're ready for a challenge, this is your opportunity to earn valuable rewards – just be careful, it won’t go down easy!
[hr][/hr]🛡️ New Craftable Shield (Rare)
A powerful rare shield has been added to the game!
You can now unlock its blueprint through the Base Master. Once you’ve learned the blueprint, head to the blacksmith to start crafting your new defense gear and shield yourself from incoming threats.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/21632b26d13ea62bfb4399d570cde1863023dff7.png"]
[hr][/hr]🔧 Base Master Updates
Big improvements here!
The Base Master now gives you access to all currently available blueprints, plus construction jobs needed to unlock more weapons and crafting NPCs. No more searching around — everything you need starts at the Base Master!
[hr][/hr]🍷 New Event Potion Item
A brand new event potion has been added to the Shop and is also available through the Alchemist NPC. Grab these while you can! They could give you that edge you need on harder challenges.
[hr][/hr]🌍 Prepare for the Outlands
With these changes, you’ll start getting a taste of the true power levels you’ll face in the Outlands — coming very soon!
Now is the perfect time to level up, fine-tune your build, and stockpile resources. Once the Outlands drop... you'll want to be ready, or you may face a world that destroys the unprepared!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all for continuing to explore, support, and enjoy Dungeon Reborn!
And as always — don’t forget to join us on Discord! I’m active daily for bug reports, feedback, or just to chat with the community. Let's continue building this adventure together.

Stay strong,
– PixelPulse Studio

Today marks a significant milestone in your journey with our latest major update. Floor 3 is now open, bringing dangerous new monsters, gameplay improvements, and exciting features to discover.

notes.title: Major Update Patch V1.0.0
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

It's been quite a while since our last update, and we've had some significant changes behind the scenes. Unfortunately, our former development team was disbanded, which required me to take time to reinvest and rebuild as an independent developer.

After careful consideration, I've made the exciting decision to transition from our previous 3D format to a polished 2D RPG experience. This shift better aligns with my strengths as a developer and allows me to utilize specialized software that will streamline the development process going forward.

A Heartfelt Apology

I want to sincerely apologize to all our amazing supporters who have patiently waited for updates. Your dedication means everything, and I'm thrilled to finally bring you the full access release you've been waiting for!

Looking Ahead

This release marks a new beginning, not an end. I'm committed to continuously updating and expanding the game for years to come, evolving it into the ultimate cozy, grindy RPG dungeon crawler experience. Expect regular updates, new content, and exciting expansions in the future.

What's New

Now, let's dive into the exciting changes you'll discover when you start playing!


New Game Experience


Epic Adventure Awaits

Begin your journey as a hero mysteriously transported to an unknown realm. A mystical spirit will guide you through the fundamentals of this dangerous world, teaching you essential survival skills before releasing you into full sandbox mode. From there, the pace is entirely yours—but remember, this is still a dungeon crawler at heart, and monsters lurk around every corner, ready to strike!


Core Mechanics:


🔨 Crafting System

Venture into the Tower to gather valuable resources, then return to your headquarters to craft essential upgrades for both yourself and your base. Every expedition brings new materials and possibilities for advancement.

👥 Party System  

Solo adventures have their limits! Recruit skilled mercenaries and various hero classes to join your expeditions. The Tower's deepest levels are impossible to conquer alone—teamwork is essential for survival and success.

🏗️ Building Mode

Design and construct your perfect base using our blueprint system. As you progress and upgrade, new construction options and features will unlock, giving you even more ways to customize your headquarters. (More building content coming soon!)



What's Next?

These features are just the beginning! I'm committed to releasing substantial updates throughout this week and next, so stay tuned for exciting new content.


Join Our Community  


Don't forget to join our Discord server! I'm actively engaged there as the developer, ready to:



Chat with players directly

Receive bug reports and feedback

Share immediate patch notes and updates

Host community discussions



I'm also planning to introduce a community idea hub where you can influence the world's economy—this will become increasingly important as we develop the Grand Bazaar feature!



https://discord.gg/Ya9KwQmy34



Thank you all for your incredible support and patience. Enjoy the adventure!



Happy Gaming!



Greetings,

PixelPulse Studio

notes.title: Unlocking Early Access
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Hunters! It's been a while since my last update on the game's development. Unfortunately, I was hospitalized and couldn't provide you with more information sooner. However, I'm thrilled to be back and fully committed to making this game enjoyable for all of you.

Today, I'm excited to share some exciting new content coming in the early access release. The release date will be either this week or early next week, depending on how quickly Steam approves our request. I'm working diligently to make that happen.

Let's delve into the exciting and engaging aspects of the topic.


 Story & Class select.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/1d61c1371bb7d9b1a5e02cc231fe496284800d10.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/a0b62ef65d0911eb0f752c238595776ea7e6368e.png

Before embarking on your journey, as depicted in the image above, you will have the opportunity to select a starting class, which will serve as your initial Hero Class.

Initially, I intended to thrust you directly into the game and allow you to begin crafting right away. However, as I progressed in the game's development, I realized that this approach lacked a sense of satisfaction. As a result, I overhauled the entire system and implemented several modifications to enhance your enjoyment from the outset of your journey. Incorporating a compelling storyline into the game will further breathe life into the world I am creating for you all to experience.

My vision is to craft a world that evolves over time, where you begin as a humble hunter and gradually ascend to the position of a mighty king, leading your army against monstrous foes and formidable bosses. Of course, this path will be fraught with challenges, but you will discover more about this as the development process unfolds.


 World & Dungeon System


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/b82f64b2f63e281d446024802a70d06cd5ecf616.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/20c073176d802b8ea5f035b49385ea3c3dafb75a.png

In this dungeon crawler game, you embark on a journey through an expansive open-world map. This realm, consisting of a colossal tower connecting various lands, is home to humans and other species. The tower has 100 floors, with only ten currently inhabited and ruled by the king and protected by the guild. However, strange portals have begun to emerge on each floor, releasing hordes of monsters that kill and kidnap people.

The only way to stop this menace is to enter the portals and defeat the bosses within. Unfortunately, the portals perpetually respawn, making it impossible to keep them closed. No one has yet found a way to permanently seal these portals, leaving the world in a state of constant peril.

As the narrative unfolds, we shall uncover a path to liberate our world from the clutches of these monstrous entities.

I aspire to craft a unique dungeon-crawling experience, amalgamating the essence of traditional dungeon crawling with the boundless possibilities of an open-world system. The choice of pixel 2D art as my primary design aesthetic was influenced by my desire to prioritize the game's mechanics and visual appeal. The nostalgic charm of old-school RPGs resonates deeply with me, and I believe this aesthetic complements my vision for the game.


 Battle System


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/a4f4d23d59ea3a9d3d48edde03319682b8bb1e17.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/0a84e38fc773a13e7b9e126ff49c5c0adb968827.png


In this turn-based battle system, players must carefully consider their actions as enemies are formidable. Strategizing is essential, including building a balanced team with a combination of tanks, DPS, and healers. Hybrid classes will also be available, but more details will be provided later. Remember, failure to adapt your team to each battle's unique challenges will result in defeat.





 Class & Emblem System


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/61d352f0cc3e553ebdf7d52a3d060720b32f8d71.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/e8e05b5999ee0e4fd9b67f0c8142c2e9e294c2dd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/b75f69dfcd8a10500b89dc315ee9dd08b425c23d.png


Dungeon Reborn features two distinct classes at the outset: Hero classes and Mercenaries. Hero classes serve as your primary frontline fighters, delivering more significant damage than Mercenaries. However, they are more challenging to obtain and maintain within your party due to their higher cost.

To ensure your success, it's vital to carefully select the best class for each stage of your journey. Rapid growth without sufficient capital support can lead to financial ruin and defeat. Therefore, manage your empire wisely and prioritize hiring the right classes to maintain a balanced and sustainable army.

When hiring and crafting new armor and weapons, it's important to keep in mind that hero classes will have access to all armor types, while mercenaries have unique armor specifically designed for them.

Throughout your journey, you'll have the opportunity to obtain Emblems. These Emblems enhance your power and possess their own unique level system. Some Emblems even evolve into entirely new Emblems once they reach their maximum level. It's crucial to regularly check which Emblems you can unlock to further augment your strength. It's worth noting that only Hero classes have the ability to utilize Emblems.


 Quest System


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141283/ae6243456bafea4f22866cc655f6eee8da8e03ec.png

In every RPG game, a quest system is essential. Let's delve deeper into the quest system of this game. There are three types of quests: Guild Tasks, Rank-up Quests, and Bounties.

The main storyline is provided through Guild Tasks. Completing these tasks unlocks new systems and locations within the world. After some time, the guild will invite you to undertake Rank-up Quests. Your rank determines the quality of quests you receive, with higher ranks leading to better rewards.

Bounties are more suited for the endgame. Non-player characters (NPCs) in the world may sometimes request your assistance in defeating a boss or monster in the field. Successfully completing these bounties grants valuable gold and crafting materials. End-game bounties are particularly important for obtaining powerful armor and weapons.

While I am actively working on implementing much more into the game, this is just a small portion of what it has to offer. I am determined to continue improving the game and its development for the future. After the full release, the game will have seasons already planned to be released after launch. This means a continuous stream of content will be added to enhance the game and make it even better.

For now, I hope all you hunters are prepared to embark on your journey and create your own empire in the realm of Dungeon Reborn.

notes.title: Upcoming Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters,

In just two weeks, the game will be available in early access. I am working tirelessly to implement new features and improve gameplay for the upcoming release.

Here are some details on what I am currently working on:

1. A new Medal system: This feature allows players to complete challenges within dungeons to earn medals that provide significant stat boosts and other benefits. These medals can be a game changer in certain situations.

2. Gathering and Building: I am currently developing two different setups for players to build their main base, where they will spend most of their time before heading out on hunts in the Dungeons. I am continuously exploring ways to add new and exciting elements while maintaining balance.

3. Leveling and Skill Leveling: The maximum level cap for the game will be 99 for now (subject to change in future updates), but that's not all - your skills also have their own levels that increase as you use them, up to level 99. This may also be expanded upon in future updates, with each level providing a boost to your skill powers.

And there's much more to come! For now, I wish you all a fantastic day. Don't forget to Wishlist the game if you're interested, and feel free to join our Discord server to stay updated on development and chat with me, the developer, for more information about the upcoming game.
